summary: Implemented the rich.progress file-reading feature without committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext, private _make_file_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file with typed overloads, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads); tests/test_progress.py (22 new tests before the __main__ block); docs/source/progress.rst (two subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Added bullet, PR 1759). Not run: tests, mypy, black. Deviations to check: added delegating mode and name properties on the reader (needed so it instantiates on Python 3.6); module-level open returns Any in its implementation; no extra type-ignore comments beyond the spec's three. Risk: RawIOBase plus BinaryIO multiple inheritance and the TextIOWrapper wrap are unverified at runtime on 3.6.
